messages:
Noah Kim: Hi all 144b - first week remote. I got my Mac and dock, but can't join the company Wi-Fi from home when I'm on the office VPN. The Wi-Fi SSID shows but it fails to authenticate. Also the onboarding tracker shows my monitor shipped but I never got a delivery notice. Who should I ping for the monitor ETA and any Wi-Fi/VPN tips?

IT - Elena: Welcome Noah! Quick clarifying Qs: Are you trying to connect to the office SSID over your home network (i.e., from home) or are you at the office? If remote, you should be on your home Wi-Fi and then start the VPN client; you won't see the office SSID from home. If you're at the office and Wi-Fi won't auth, share the error message (401/802.1x prompt?).

Noah Kim: Sorry, I'm remote (SF area). I meant: I connect to my home Wi-Fi fine, then I start the Redwood VPN client (company-provided) and internal services can't be reached. The VPN client connects but DNS doesn't resolve internal hostnames (e.g., internal-confluence). The VPN client shows "Connected (split-tunnel)".

IT - Elena: Got it. Two quick checks: 1) Open the VPN client > Settings > Ensure "Use company DNS while connected" is toggled on. 2) On mac, run: `scutil --dns` and paste the Search Domains / DNS Server entries. If split-tunnel is expected we still push our DNS via the client. Also check whether your MDM pushed the network profile: System Settings > Profiles should list "Redwood VPN + DNS".

Noah Kim: VPN client shows connected and toggle is on. `scutil --dns` shows search domain: none. System Settings > Profiles is empty (no profiles).

IT - Elena: If MDM profile is missing profile then enrollment might not have finished. Try opening Company Portal and re-run enrollment. If that doesn't work, I'll push the network profile manually once we confirm your device serial. Can you run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep "Serial Number"` and paste the serial?

Noah Kim: Serial pasted privately in IT ticket. I re-ran Company Portal, it said "Profile installed" but System Settings still empty.

VPN-Bot: Automatic DNS push attempted for device (serial masked). Status: pending. If status doesn't change in 10m, open IT ticket with subject: "VPN DNS profile missing".

IT - Elena: Thanks - I see the pending state on our side. I'll force a re-provision in 5. Re: monitor: @Omar / Logistics Bot can confirm shipment. If you're remote we normally reroute monitors to home address by request.

Logistics Bot: Shipment RDW-115773 status: out_for_delivery -> delivery_exception (attempted delivery, no safe place), last_scan=2026-01-14 18:02 UTC, carrier=QuickFleet, current_location=Local Hub SF. Estimated next attempt: 2026-01-15. To reroute to alternate address, reply with "REROUTE: <address>".

People Ops - Omar: @Noah if you want the monitor delivered to your home, reply here with the address and I'll mark it high priority. Alternatively we can hold at SF HQ and Facilities can drop a spare to your desk if you plan to be in-office next week.

Noah Kim: I'm remote this month. Please reroute to my home: 1234 Juniper Ave, Apt 2B, San Francisco, CA. Thanks!

Logistics Bot: REROUTE request received for RDW-115773: new_address=1234 Juniper Ave Apt 2B SF CA, action=reroute_to_residential, priority=high. Courier will attempt redelivery tomorrow morning.

IT - Elena: DNS push succeeded on our side, can you now run `scutil --dns` again and try `ping internal-confluence.redwood`?

Noah Kim: DNS now shows search domain `internal.redwood` and internal-confluence ping resolves. Everything works 44d. Thanks Elena!

Facilities - Priya: Noted on the spare monitor option. If you're ever visiting SF, ping me and I can reserve a spare for checkout.

Noah Kim: Awesome, appreciate the quick turnaround and help from everyone! :tada:
